about: Prompts for the AI place art (FLUX.1-schnell, Apache-2.0, via the public evalstate/flux1_schnell Space). The queue is in order of how often players see each place; daily.py works down it, 7 a day on the free GPU allowance. 'done' lists scenes already in public/scenes.
style: Full-frame realistic photograph, no borders, no letterbox, moody teal and amber color grade, subtle film grain, gritty crime drama atmosphere, absolutely no text, no signs, no lettering, no inscriptions, no logos, people only as small distant silhouettes

scenes.academy: Old brick police and law academy building with arched windows at dusk, lit hallways, empty courtyard with a flagpole, light rain
scenes.bank: Grand old bank interior at night, marble floor, brass teller cages, a heavy round vault door ajar, warm desk lamps, plain blank walls
scenes.boardwalk: Seaside wooden boardwalk and pier at dusk, warm string lights, shuttered snack kiosks, sand, calm sea, a lone figure under the pier
scenes.casino: Casino floor at night, rows of green felt card tables and a roulette wheel under warm chandeliers, haze of smoke, deep red carpet
scenes.checkpoint: Cold empty city street with a concrete guard booth, red and white striped barrier arm and floodlights at night, snow on the curb, plain grey apartment blocks with dark windows
scenes.city: Aerial view of a dense old city at night, wet streets glowing with streetlights, rooftops and water towers, distant bridge, low clouds
scenes.cityhall: Old neoclassical government building with tall columns and wide stone steps at night, smooth plain stone pediment, wet pavement reflecting warm streetlights, light rain
scenes.court: Empty wood-panelled courtroom at night, judge's bench, witness stand, jury box and gallery benches, single beams of light through tall windows
scenes.courthousehill: Hilltop street of marble law buildings with wide steps at night, iron lamp posts, wet cobblestones, fog rolling in
scenes.crimescene: Narrow back alley at night taped off with yellow police tape, blue and red light glow on wet brick walls, a dropped bag on the ground, small evidence markers
scenes.exchange: Financial district at night, tall stone bank buildings and a modern glass tower, empty plaza with fountains, palm trees, warm windows
scenes.foundry: Old city fire station at night, red brick, three tall arched garage doors open with a red fire engine inside, wet street, steam
scenes.gutter: Underneath a concrete highway overpass at night, makeshift tents and shopping carts, a burning barrel, puddles, bare concrete pillars
scenes.halcyon: Futuristic glass skyscraper skyline at night, clean wide avenues, cold blue light, elevated walkways, rain mist
scenes.highrise: Small rented city apartment at night seen from inside, unmade bed and a desk lamp, rain on the window, city lights beyond
scenes.hospital: Old city hospital corridor at night, pale green walls, empty gurney, flickering fluorescent lights, an open door to a lit ward
scenes.interrogation: Police interrogation room, metal table with two chairs, a single hanging lamp, one-way mirror, cigarette smoke, plain case folders on the table
scenes.ironmoor: Cold industrial city at night, smokestacks and steel cranes, snow-dusted rail tracks, sodium street lamps, heavy grey sky
scenes.ironrow: Old factory and warehouse street at night, loading docks, steam from manholes, chain-link fences, a lit back-room doorway
scenes.lab: Hidden makeshift chemistry lab in a dim basement, glass flasks and tubing on a steel table, a hanging bulb, plastic sheeting on the walls
scenes.marina: Harbor marina at night, luxury yachts beside rusty cargo ships, stacked shipping containers, cranes, reflections on dark water
scenes.oldmarket: Old market street at night, closed metal shop shutters and street stalls, a warm diner window glowing, wet cobblestones
scenes.police: City police headquarters at night, old stone building with green lamps by the entrance, patrol cars parked outside, blue and red light glow
scenes.pound: City animal shelter kennel at night, row of chain-link dog runs under warm lights, a large dog looking through the fence, concrete floor
scenes.precinct: Busy police squad room at night, rows of cluttered desks, a cork board with pinned photos and red string, ceiling fans, rain on the windows
scenes.prison: Prison yard at night, tall concrete walls topped with razor wire, a guard tower with a searchlight, empty basketball hoop, wet asphalt
scenes.railyards: Freight rail yard at night, rows of old boxcars and coal cars, coal smoke, signal lights, a small fire between the tracks
scenes.solace: Seaside resort city at dusk, palm-lined beachfront avenue, pastel hotels, glowing lights in the distance, calm ocean
scenes.southside: Run-down tenement block at night, fire escapes zigzagging up brick walls, laundry lines, a single streetlight, an empty basketball court
scenes.station: Old grand train station concourse at night, high arched iron and glass roof, a few travellers, steam, warm lamps
scenes.stbrigids: Old Victorian city hospital building at night, lit windows, an ambulance in the bay, wet street, stone archway
scenes.street: Rainy city street at night, traffic light trails, colored glow on wet asphalt, steam from a grate, a figure in a long coat under a streetlight
scenes.techpark: Modern tech campus at night, glass office buildings, rows of server racks visible through windows glowing blue, empty landscaped plaza
scenes.undercity: Dark streets beneath elevated megastructures, concrete pillars disappearing up into darkness, flickering lights, puddles, food stalls with steam
